title: rosa onoei f. plena
intro: Rosa onoei f. plena, commonly known as Japanese rose or Japanese tea rose, is a fragrant and flowering plant species in the rose family. It is used in traditional herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are believed to include stress relief, improved sleep quality, and immune system support due to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Rosa onoei f. plena include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
